title: Psalm 91 Songs for Sleep & Protection | 24/7 Scripture Song Sleep Stream
description:
Fall asleep peacefully under the protection of God's Word. This 10-hour loop of Psalm 91 is designed to bring you comfort, relieve nighttime anxiety, and cover your home in prayer while you sleep.

Unlike traditional spoken-word audio Bibles, this livestream features 45 beautifully arranged, unique Scripture Songs—singing the exact, word-for-word text of Psalm 91 (Berean Standard Bible) in multiple musical styles.

"He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty. I will say to the LORD, 'You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.'" (Psalm 91:1-2)

Whether you are struggling with insomnia, feeling overwhelmed by fear, or simply wanting to rest in the presence of God, let the lyrics of Psalm 91 wash over you all night. God promises that His faithfulness will be your shield, and that He will command His angels to guard you in all your ways.

What to expect in this video: 🎵 45 unique musical arrangements of Psalm 91 📖 Word-for-word Scripture lyrics (BSB) 🌙 10+ hours of continuous, uninterrupted play 🛡️ Peaceful worship for sleep, protection, and anxiety relief

Subscribe to Devotion Room for more word-for-word Scripture songs and biblical reflections.
